data.body:
Investigation complete. Root causes identified:

Pattern 1 (Recurring tool error tickets): error-sweep.sh THRESHOLD=50 was too low, creating noise tickets for common operational errors. Fixed by raising to THRESHOLD=500. This prevents tickets for error categories with <500 occurrences.

Pattern 2 (Duplicate defer tickets from respond-to-pr-comments): The defer handler _handle_defer() consolidates multiple defers from the same PR into one ticket via a tag lookup (pr-<N>-deferred). This consolidation fails when Step 4 calls are parallelized — all 80 calls see no existing ticket before any of them creates one. Fixed by adding explicit sequential processing requirement in SKILL.md Step 4.

Fix applied:
- plugins/dso/scripts/end-session/error-sweep.sh: THRESHOLD 50 → 500
- plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md: Added CRITICAL sequential processing note in Step 4
- tests updated to reflect new threshold
